# FIT test fixtures

## garmin-fenix-5-run.fit
- **Source**: `tests/files/garmin-fenix-5-run.fit` from [python-fitparse](https://github.com/dtcooper/python-fitparse)
- **Origin license**: MIT License (Copyright (c) Daniel Cooper et al.)
- **Content**: ~21 GPS records, a short Garmin fenix 5 run activity (lat ~38.23°N, lon ~-122.63°W)
- **License compatibility**: MIT is compatible with this project's GPL-3.0-or-later
- **Imported**: 2026-07-14, for FITParser end-to-end integration test
- **Why not garmin-fit-sdk's own samples**: garmin-fit-sdk has no LICENSE file (GitHub/PyPI `license: null`), so its test files cannot be copied into a GPL project. python-fitparse is MIT-licensed and explicitly redistributable.
